headlines.title: Why a Democratic Sweep Is Crushing GE Vernova and More Industrial Stocks
headlines.summary: Remember the rule of three before buying into popular industrial stocks after the postelection, AI backlash wipe out.

headlines.title: Data Center Stocks Just Plunged After the Midterms. Is It Time to Buy the Dip?
headlines.summary: A Democratic sweep and a new Texas governor who wants to pause data center construction sent AI-infrastructure stocks tumbling. Here's what changed, and what didn't.

headlines.title: GE Vernova Sinks 10%, Vistra Down 12% as Democrats Win Congress: “Incrementally More Negative Sentiment”
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysGE Vernova fell 10% today, with Vistra and Constellation Energy, after Democrats won both chambers of Congress. Only about 20% of GE Vernova’s contracted gas turbine capacity serves data centers.

headlines.title: Vertiv Sinks 9%, GE Vernova Down 8% as Democrats Win Congress, Reviving Data Center Fears
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysVertiv fell 9% today after Democrats won Congress, dragging GE Vernova, Eaton and CoreWeave down too. Developers will still need Vertiv’s gear even if they pay more for power, so the selloff looks overdone.

headlines.title: GE Vernova Soars 6%, Eaton Up 7% on Record Orders and Bernstein’s Data Center Call
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysGE Vernova shares rose 6% on Nov. 3 after Eaton’s record third-quarter orders and a bullish Bernstein note on data centers.

description: GE Vernova Inc., an energy company, engages in the provision of various products and services that generate, transfer, orchestrate, convert, and store electricity in the United States, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. The company operates through three segments: Power, Wind, and Electrification. The Power segment designs, manufactures, and services gas, nuclear, hydro, and steam technologies. It serves industrial, government, and other customers. The Wind segment offers wind generation technologies, including onshore and offshore wind turbines and blades. The Electrification segment provides grid solutions; power conversion; electrification software; and solar and storage solutions technologies required for the transmission, distribution, conversion, storage, and orchestration of electricity from point of generation to point of consumption. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
